{
  "report": "Author: R70ReviewerSrc (reviewer)

# Non-author source spot-check — registry delta S170–S172

Re-opened all three URLs live (curl -fsSL --compressed, browser UA, into scratch /fast/scratch/hyaku/kagi-r70/R70ReviewerSrc) on 2026-11-08. Byte-compared each live body against the committed capture .ufo/waves/round-70/capture/S17x.body and the corpus/source-fetches.tsv row, located each row's quote with rendered-text-v1.py locate, checked the corpus/SOURCES.md registry rows (11 cells, status/used-by, tier), judged the three gate decisions, and verified the five ## Measured statements of corpus/knowledge/openbao-pki-certificate-lifecycle.md against S170/S171 text.

## Live re-open (all byte-identical)

S170 https://openbao.org/docs/api/secret/pki/ HTTP 200 — 620683 B sha256 9fa7693967f32958aff9c96faf5835afa4d72894727a8d63c324e9145e5c1123 in capture, live body, and TSV row; quote 16 words, count=2.
S171 https://openbao.org/docs/secrets/pki/ HTTP 200 — 27950 B sha256 c0ec7fbc2243e7e953335d794f9c411dfe3a0c20bc35178b730cb095c66ab695 in capture, live body, and TSV row; quote 15 words, count=1.
S172 https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/api-docs/secret/pki HTTP 200 — 2518415 B sha256 65104f6b661da48921f707d02170e88e52dd78cdb32ae03b2bc6d9aa6e061ddd in capture, live body, and TSV row; quote 8 words, count=2.

Normalized digests re-computed (digest on committed + live) all match TSV normalized_sha256 (S170 0419f2a3..66eae93 164032 norm bytes; S171 93bb8048..169879f 3149; S172 bc75882d..af5c630 187678). size_download on the wire differs (68891/6908/165006) because --compressed+decoded-http-body-v1 digest the decompressed body — no discrepancy. Receipts in .ufo/waves/round-70/w1/R70ReviewerSrc/live-fetch-receipts.txt and quote-locates.txt.

## Registry rows (SOURCES.md)

Header 11-column; all three rows exactly 11 cells. S170: docs/A/mined/2026-11-08/on-release/used-by corpus/knowledge/openbao-pki-certificate-lifecycle.md — entry source: names S170+S171, file exists, triangle closes. S171: docs/A/mined/2026-11-08/on-release/same used-by — tier A matches vendor-primary OpenBao docs convention (S014/S016/S025/S026); quote verbatim on page. S172: docs/A/rejected/2026-11-08/180d/used-by corpus/lessons/round-70.md — REJECTED:+flip: present (SC_REJECT_SHAPE passes); used-by to the lesson file matches S156/S169 precedent (most rejected rows use —); census does not require rejected used-by paths to exist (SC_USEDBY_MISSING is mined-only) and is CLEAN. No cell/enum/tier/status defects.

## Gate decisions

S170 admit — AGREE: OpenBao PKI API docs state all round mechanics (internal/exported, max_ttl/allowed_domains/allow_any_name/no_store, ttl bound, revoke+CRL); count=2 across §Generate key/§Generate intermediate; legacy /api-docs/ 328B stub handled.
S171 admit — AGREE: opening section states short-TTL rationale verbatim (15 words, count=1); admitted only for that rationale, matching the plan's lesson-Gate note.
S172 reject — AGREE: Vault page is a different product line; identical ttl sentence exists on both pages (S170 x3, S172 x2) so it is tempting but illegitimate authority for OpenBao behaviour; rejection + flip ('a claim about Vault itself, measured on a Vault binary') is right, and checked that all five behaviours are on S170 — rejecting is safe only because of that.

## Five ## Measured statements

T1 root-internal: S170-supported ('if it is internal the private key will not be returned...', 5x) + exported control is the same sentence's first half.
T2 ttl-clamp: correctly split — doc part is the bound ('Cannot be greater than the role's max_ttl', 3x); produced behaviour (issued, 3630s, warning) marked as measurement ('enforced as a clamp, not a refusal'); plan flags it measured, not sourced.
T3 domain-refuse: S170-supported (allowed_domains definition + allow_any_name additivity); inside/outside control is the trial's.
T4 revoke-crl: S170-supported ('A successful revocation will rotate the CRL'); CRL read is the trial's).
T5 no-store: S170-supported ('cannot be enumerated or revoked via serial number'); No value found + stored control are the trial's.
No measured value passed off as doc quote; title/header states clamp-not-refuse up front.

## Census

Lane: bash corpus/sources-census.sh — stdout SOURCES_CAPTURES: CLEAN + SOURCES_CENSUS: CLEAN (rows=163), stderr empty, rc=0.
Fleet: scripts/sources-census.sh validate --root ... kagi — stdout 26 W04 + kagi ok, stderr empty, rc=0.
+1 W04 (25→26) is S170 duplicate-url across scopes vs S105 (generate_lease scope vs lifecycle scope) — benign by contract (warnings do not affect clean lanes), same class as the 25 pre-existing. Receipts: .ufo/waves/round-70/w1/R70ReviewerSrc/{lane-census,fleet-validate}.{stdout,stderr}.txt + .rc.

## Candidate bytes

corpus/openbao-pki-trial.sh byte-identical to P1 control (sha256 200efcb2...8023d both); S170 capture sha equals round-49 S105 in-row pin — same page, correctly re-captured.

FINDING SR-1 falsifies-wording S172 used-by points to corpus/lessons/round-70.md, which does not yet exist on disk (tolerated by the gate per S156/S169 precedent; L1 writes it on integration).
FINDING SR-2 falsifies-number Fleet W04 count 25→26 (+1 S170 duplicate-url-across-scopes vs S105) is benign-by-contract (warnings do not affect clean lanes) but not mentioned in the plan's after-census line.
SEAT-STATUS: complete All three live re-opens byte-identical to captures and TSV rows; quotes located (2/1/2, all ≤25 words); 11-cell rows, mined/used-by triangles, tier A, gate decisions (admit/admit/reject) and the five Measured statements all verified; both census runs CLEAN/ok with receipts saved."
}
